about_the_game:
Skill Pack : Card of Inspiration is a special expansion born from the creativity of the community.

Featuring 9 unique skills, this pack expands the possibilities for new ideas and strategies in battle.

  • In MONSTER CARDS, cards can be exchanged as files, so even players who do not own this DLC can still play with cards that use these skills.
    What this DLC provides is the right to generate cards with these skills yourself.

Included Skills

Bravery [Standard]: Gains an advantage against opponents larger in size. (Inspiration by sakuri9616)

Rival [Standard]: Gains an advantage when facing an opponent with a similar attribute. (Inspiration by ニセモノ)

Thief [Standard]: Steals the defeated card’s ability. (Inspiration by 盲目)

Fealty [Discard]: Cannot be stolen by other players. (Inspiration by おばけだ！)

Covenanter [Discard]: Summons a familiar. (Inspiration by ももむー)

Destiny [Discard]: Plays a random card from your deck. (Inspiration by こうちゃちゃ)

Wonderland [GameChanger]: During battle, attribute matchups are nullified. (Inspiration by sakuri9616)

Abundance [GameChanger]: Draws one additional card each turn. (Inspiration by glitchedpancake)

Production [GameChanger]: Has a chance to add a product card to your hand each turn. (Inspiration by にーえぬ)
